name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.

Zero-Lag 120 FPS Native Scrolling: Eliminated 300+ concurrent GPU card animation loops and heavy backdrop filters across Search Studio (165+ items) and History grids. Added content-visibility: auto virtualization.
Search Studio Autocomplete Unclipped: Fixed dropdown container clipping bug so search suggestions cleanly float over categories without getting chopped off.
Optimized Atmospheric Ambient Meshes: Converted background and footer glow to zero-overhead pre-computed CSS radial gradients.
Crystal-Clear Legibility: Preserved obsidian dark card contrast (#0d111a) and high-visibility white/silver typography across all views.
